subject.title: [Bug]: Auto-backgrounded exec failure posts raw system card (internal agent id + command line) to end user

question: Should failed background-exec completions notify end users by default, and which command/output and agent/model metadata may appear in those notifications?
rationale: Current source deliberately asks the model to relay failed command details and deliberately renders agent/model/provider card identity, so the safe default and permitted metadata require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Private by default
options.body: Keep completion events agent-internal by default and require an explicit user-notify decision that produces sanitized text.

options.title: Sanitized automatic notice
options.body: Continue automatic failure notices but enforce neutral wording without command paths, raw agent ids, model names, or providers.

options.title: Retain detailed notices
options.body: Keep the current relay behavior and treat configured public agent identities and deployment guidance as the privacy boundary.

recommendation.title: Private by default
recommendation.body: Keep completion events agent-internal by default and require an explicit user-notify decision that produces sanitized text.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current heartbeat relay policy and has the strongest cross-boundary history on the affected implementation.
